scholarly_query: ("Human parainfluenza virus" OR HPIV OR "Human respirovirus 1" OR "Human orthorubulavirus 2" OR "Human respirovirus 3" OR "Human orthorubulavirus 4") AND (taxonomy OR species OR genus OR family OR order)
news_query: ("Human parainfluenza virus" OR HPIV OR "Human respirovirus 1" OR "Human orthorubulavirus 2" OR "Human respirovirus 3" OR "Human orthorubulavirus 4") (taxonomy OR species OR genus OR family OR order) -"influenza virus" -"bovine parainfluenza"

purpose: Identify clinical manifestations, severity and treatment
scholarly_query: (HPIV OR croup OR "parainfluenza pneumonia" OR "upper respiratory infection" OR bronchiolitis OR "viral pneumonia" OR RT‐PCR OR serology) AND (infection OR disease OR clinical OR severity OR treatment)
news_query: (HPIV OR croup OR "parainfluenza pneumonia" OR "upper respiratory infection" OR bronchiolitis OR "viral pneumonia" OR RT‐PCR OR serology) (infection OR disease OR clinical OR severity OR treatment) -"influenza virus"

purpose: Gather data on incidence, outbreaks and surveillance
scholarly_query: (HPIV OR "seasonal incidence" OR "public health surveillance" OR outbreak OR case OR prevalence OR incidence) AND (outbreak OR surveillance OR incidence OR prevalence OR case)
news_query: (HPIV OR "seasonal incidence" OR "public health surveillance" OR outbreak OR case OR prevalence OR incidence) (outbreak OR surveillance OR incidence OR prevalence OR case) -"influenza virus"

purpose: Explore host range, reservoirs and ecological aspects
scholarly_query: (Human OR "primary host" OR "childhood infection" OR "nosocomial infection") AND (host OR reservoir OR vector OR ecology OR spillover)
news_query: (Human OR "primary host" OR "childhood infection" OR "nosocomial infection") (host OR reservoir OR vector OR ecology OR spillover) -"bovine parainfluenza"

purpose: Retrieve genome sequences, phylogeny and mutation data
scholarly_query: (HPIV OR genome OR sequence OR phylogeny OR variant OR mutation OR "RNA genome" OR "negative‐sense RNA") AND (genome OR sequence OR phylogeny OR variant OR mutation)
news_query: (HPIV OR genome OR sequence OR phylogeny OR variant OR mutation OR "RNA genome" OR "negative‐sense RNA") (genome OR sequence OR phylogeny OR variant OR mutation) -"influenza virus"

purpose: Find diagnostic methods and assay performance
scholarly_query: (HPIV OR RT‐PCR OR "real‐time PCR" OR serology OR "virus isolation" OR "neutralizing antibodies" OR "diagnostic assay") AND (diagnosis OR PCR OR serology OR assay OR detection)
news_query: (HPIV OR RT‐PCR OR "real‐time PCR" OR serology OR "virus isolation" OR "neutralizing antibodies" OR "diagnostic assay") (diagnosis OR PCR OR serology OR assay OR detection) -"influenza virus"

purpose: Collect information on vaccines, control measures and public‐health interventions
scholarly_query: (HPIV OR "vaccine development" OR "live‐attenuated vaccine" OR "inactivated vaccine" OR prevention OR control OR "public health" OR intervention) AND (vaccine OR prevention OR control OR "public health" OR intervention)
news_query: (HPIV OR "vaccine development" OR "live‐attenuated vaccine" OR "inactivated vaccine" OR prevention OR control OR "public health" OR intervention) (vaccine OR prevention OR control OR "public health" OR intervention) -"influenza virus"
